SourceString: The Keeper of Storms turns the sky; the Founders' stones name it ATMOS. Its weather is never late, and the old ones say it comes harder when we are slow.
DevNotes: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (Narrative §10 Layer 1, §12). Unlocked from the start. Path key Storm.

SourceString: The Keeper of the Forge, FOUNDRY on the old stones, mends whatever breaks, the Reclaimer most of all. It sends the Reclaimer back whole every time, and asks only Ichor and patience.
DevNotes: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (Narrative §10 Layer 1, §12). Unlocked from the start. Path key Forge.

SourceString: The Keeper of Tides, CISTERN to the Founders, keeps the water under Vigil cold and moving. Of the Six it takes the smallest tithe, and some say it is the only one that listens.
DevNotes: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (Narrative §10 Layer 1, §12). Unlocked from the start. Path key Tide.

SourceString: The Keeper of the Dead keeps the record, LEDGER in the Founders' hand: every birth, every death, every debt. What it files is never lost, and never given back.
DevNotes: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (Narrative §10 Layer 1, §12). Unlocked from the start. Path key Shade.

SourceString: The Keeper of Light, LUMEN, keeps the lamps of the Keep burning through every night. Ask it a question and it answers that question exactly, and nothing more.
DevNotes: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (Narrative §10 Layer 1, §12). Unlocked from the start. Path key Radiance.

SourceString: The Keeper of Ways, RELAY on the stones, carries everything that moves in the Keep: water, light, Ichor, us. It never rests, and it does not like to see anything else at rest.
DevNotes: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (Narrative §10 Layer 1, §12). Unlocked from the start. Path key Quicksilver.

SourceString: ROOT — [no data]
DevNotes: First-win entry (Narrative §10 stop line; Roadmap W5 Thu). Title only, no body. ROOT is a designation: same string in every culture (§13.2).

SourceString: The Reclaimer came back from the Breach carrying more than it took in. It always does, and Vigil is always glad.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Reach L10 in a run -> Flak Mortar. Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: The Cast-offs come in numbers no one in Vigil has counted to the end. The Reclaimer is the only thing that goes in to meet them.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Kill 500 enemies with Scatter Cannon -> Scatter Shell. Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: The Reclaimer wakes in its room with nothing in its head but its trade. Vigil keeps the room swept and asks it no questions.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Raise a weapon to L8 -> Overclock (Discovery.WeaponL8). Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: Every machine in the Breach was made by the Six for some work, long ago. What the work was, Vigil has forgotten; what they do now, it knows too well.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Destroy 1 000 Cast-offs in one run -> Magnify (Discovery.Kills1000). Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: When the Breach runs cold the Cast-offs slow, and the water under Vigil goes quiet. People say the Keeper of Tides is grieving, though no one can say for what.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Freeze 100 enemies -> Ring Emitter. Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: Struck true, a Cast-off breaks open and spills Ichor as bright as lamplight. The Keeper of Light is said to watch such blows more closely than the rest.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Deal a 500+ crit -> Crit Lens. Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: The Keepers speak to the Reclaimer and never to us. Those who have overheard them say the Six do not always agree.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Destroy 300 with Rail Lance -> Heavy Slug (Discovery.RailKills300). Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: Tallymen keep counting even as they fall, and the Keeper of the Dead files every one. Vigil wonders whose account is being kept.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Destroy 10 elites in one run -> Burst Capacitor (Discovery.Elites10). Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: The Keeper of Storms wants the work done faster; the Keeper of Tides wants less of it done at all. A tithe that pleases one slights the other.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Reach Tier 2 on two Paths -> Spread Wave (Discovery.TwoPaths6). Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: The old tallies say the Cast-offs come out on a schedule, never early, never late. Machines that escape do not keep time.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Survive 10:00 -> Arc Blade, Seeker Swarm (Narrative §10: Layer 2 channel). Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: The strongest Cast-offs carry more Ichor than anything thrown away should. Someone keeps filling them.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Kill an elite with >= 3 modifiers on one weapon -> Chain Trigger (Narrative §10: Layer 2 channel). Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: The Six have another name for the Breach: the Yard. A yard is where you leave things you mean to collect.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Dash 100 times in one run -> Velocity Coil (Discovery.Dashes100). Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: Each run, the Six take their share of the Ichor before FOUNDRY rebuilds the Reclaimer. No one has seen that share go back into the Breach, yet the Breach never runs dry.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Destroy 300 with Orbital Drones -> Lingering Field (Discovery.DroneKills300). Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: Vigil's tithe and the Reclaimer's returns end up in the same place. The Six have never once refused either.
DevNotes: Recollection (Narrative §10, GDD §8.3). Discovery: Reach Tier 3 on any Path -> Lifeline (Discovery.Favor9). Vigil's voice; 1-2 sentences.

SourceString: When the Warden fell the Breach went quiet, and the Keepers said one word: noted. Before the next run, something was moving in the Yard again.
